alterminal.ptyDaemon.enabled.markdownDescription: Keep terminal processes alive across window reloads. When enabled, PTY processes are managed by a background daemon that persists independently of the VS Code extension host. **Experimental.**

enumDescriptions: Automatically switch between horizontal and vertical based on panel size
Always use horizontal tabs (tabs on top)
Always use vertical tabs (tabs on left side)

alterminal.alwaysShowTabs.description: Always show the tab bar, even when there is only one terminal tab

alterminal.tabTitle.template.description: Template for tab titles using tokens like {n} (name), {base} (base name), {p} (process), {title} (OSC terminal title), {cwd} (directory). Supports conditionals: {p?text} and defaults: {p:shell}

alterminal.tabTitle.maxLength.description: Maximum length for tab titles before truncation

alterminal.tabTitle.truncateMode.description: How to truncate long tab titles

alterminal.clearSelectionOnCopy.description: Clear the text selection after copying to clipboard. Disable to keep text selected after Cmd/Ctrl+C.

alterminal.suppressFocusStealingSequence.markdownDescription: Strip escape sequences from PTY output that VS Code (or other apps) react to by stealing focus to their own terminal. Covers OSC 7 (CWD), OSC 9 (notifications/CWD), OSC 133 (FinalTerm), OSC 633 (VS Code shell integration), OSC 1337 (iTerm2), and DEC ?1004 (focus reporting). Disable if you rely on these sequences passing through to other tooling.

alterminal.bellIndicator.markdownDescription: Text shown in the window title when a background terminal has unread bell activity. Add `${bell}` to your `#window.title#` setting to enable. Set to empty string to disable.

alterminal.bellAwareTimeoutMinutes.markdownDescription: After a tab emits a bell, Alterminal trusts it as the canonical attention signal and suppresses the background-activity dot from regular stdout (avoiding false flashes from spinners and re-draws). If no further bell arrives within this many minutes, the tab reverts to normal activity-on-stdout behavior. Set to `0` to disable bell-aware mode entirely (every stdout chunk flashes the dot).

markdownEnumDescriptions: GPU-accelerated WebGL renderer (default). Fastest, but uses a shared glyph texture atlas.
xterm's built-in DOM renderer. Slower, no glyph atlas — useful for diagnosing rendering artifacts or on machines where WebGL is unreliable.
Experimental WebGPU renderer. Newer GPU path with a correctly-keyed atlas (avoids the WebGL atlas-bleed artifacts). Falls back to xterm's DOM renderer if WebGPU is unavailable.
alterminal.renderer.markdownDescription: Terminal renderer. `webgl` is GPU-accelerated (default). `dom` uses xterm's built-in DOM renderer with no glyph atlas. `webgpu` is the experimental WebGPU renderer. **Reload the window after changing.**

alterminal.savedCommands.markdownDescription:
Saved terminal commands for quick launching. Commands support template variables that expand at launch time:

| Token | Value |
|-------|-------|
| `{workspace}` | Workspace folder name |
| `{workspacePath}` | Full workspace folder path |
| `{user}` | OS username |
| `{platform}` | `process.platform` (darwin, linux, win32) |
| `{env.VAR}` | Environment variable `VAR` |
| `{i:prompt}` | Interactive — prompts user at launch time |

Supports conditionals: `{workspace:default}`, `{workspace?then:else}`. Unknown tokens are left as-is. Use `{i:prompt}` in `cwd` for a folder picker or in `command` for an input box.

alterminal.terminal.scrollback.markdownDescription: Number of lines to keep in terminal scrollback buffer. Inherits from `#terminal.integrated.scrollback#` when unset.

alterminal.fontFamily.markdownDescription: Terminal font family. Inherits from `#terminal.integrated.fontFamily#` when unset.

alterminal.fontSize.markdownDescription: Terminal font size in pixels. Inherits from `#terminal.integrated.fontSize#` when unset.

alterminal.fontWeight.markdownDescription: Terminal font weight for normal text. Inherits from `#terminal.integrated.fontWeight#` when unset.

alterminal.fontWeightBold.markdownDescription: Terminal font weight for bold text. Inherits from `#terminal.integrated.fontWeightBold#` when unset.

alterminal.lineHeight.markdownDescription: Terminal line height as a multiplier of font size. Inherits from `#terminal.integrated.lineHeight#` when unset.

alterminal.letterSpacing.markdownDescription: Terminal letter spacing in pixels. Inherits from `#terminal.integrated.letterSpacing#` when unset.

alterminal.cursorStyle.markdownDescription: Terminal cursor style. Inherits from `#terminal.integrated.cursorStyle#` when unset.

alterminal.cursorBlinking.markdownDescription: Blink the terminal cursor. Inherits from `#terminal.integrated.cursorBlinking#` when unset.

alterminal.copyOnSelection.markdownDescription: Automatically copy terminal selection to the clipboard. Inherits from `#terminal.integrated.copyOnSelection#` when unset.

alterminal.smoothScrolling.markdownDescription: Animate terminal scrolling. Inherits from `#terminal.integrated.smoothScrolling#` when unset.

alterminal.minimumContrastRatio.markdownDescription: Minimum contrast ratio for text — adjusts colors to meet WCAG. Inherits from `#terminal.integrated.minimumContrastRatio#` when unset.

alterminal.wordSeparators.markdownDescription: Characters treated as word boundaries for double-click word selection. Inherits from `#terminal.integrated.wordSeparators#` when unset.
